title: Why gulping ice water sends your stomach into shock
caption:
Ice water heaven - until your stomach protests
A sweaty cartoon guy chugs a whole pitcher of ice water and comically freezes over mid-sip.
Gulping ice water drops your stomach temperature too fast, triggering a smooth muscle spasm that slows digestion down - so sip slowly.
Ever felt that icy cramp right after chugging a cold drink?
Save this for the next heatwave and follow for more daily body facts.
